title: One candidate covering two items in a shared named root credits its recognised test to only one bound item
outcome: When one exact candidate in a shared named root legitimately serves more than one claimed item, its registered test can be credited to each item it verifies, or the host documents and enforces a clear supported workflow that does not require rerunning the same test.
acceptance: The rule that reports a recognised test in a shared named root for one bound item only is located in code, and its intent is documented: safety reason versus limitation.

Either multi-item credit for one exact run is supported with a regression test, or the notice and docs give a supported path that needs no duplicate run. The notice never advises rerunning a test that already passed only to move credit.
